title: Lion cub in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- lion cub body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#F5B342'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='80' width='10' height='14' rx='5' fill='#E89A2A'/>
  <rect x='58' y='80' width='10' height='14' rx='5' fill='#E89A2A'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='93' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#FFD98A'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='93' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#FFD98A'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 74 Q86 72 84 60' stroke='#E89A2A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='58' r='6' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='24' fill='#F5B342'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='26' fill='#C77A22'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='22' fill='#F5B342'/>

  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='7' fill='#F5B342'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='7' fill='#F5B342'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='3.5' fill='#FFD98A'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='3.5' fill='#FFD98A'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#FFE3B0'/>

  <circle cx='41' cy='39' r='4' fill='#5A3410'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='39' r='4' fill='#5A3410'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='37.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFF6DC'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='37.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFF6DC'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M46 47 L54 47 L50 51 Z' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 51 L50 54 M50 54 Q46 57 43 55 M50 54 Q54 57 57 55' stroke='#B5651D' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M26 62 Q50 70 74 62 Q76 68 74 72 Q50 80 26 72 Q24 68 26 62 Z' fill='#D93B3B'/>
  <path d='M26 62 Q50 70 74 62' stroke='#FF7A7A' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M60 70 Q68 76 64 84 Q60 88 56 84 Q54 78 60 70 Z' fill='#D93B3B'/>
  <path d='M60 70 Q64 76 62 80' stroke='#FF7A7A' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <path d='M35 64 L35 71' stroke='#FFE08A' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <path d='M50 67 L50 75' stroke='#FFE08A' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <path d='M65 64 L65 71' stroke='#FFE08A' stroke-width='2.5'/>
</svg>
